rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when someone needs to think something over carefully before responding or deciding.

example.english: I ruminate over it all night and still haven’t decided how to answer you.
example.traditional: 我反覆咁諗咗成晚，仲未決定好點樣答你。
example.jyutping: ngo5 faan2 fuk1 gam3 nam2 zo2 seng4 maan5 zung6 mei6 kyut3 ding6 hou2 dim2 joeng2 daap3 nei5

rows.note: Use this formal term specifically for a ruminant bringing food back up and chewing it again.

example.english: Cows ruminate their food, chewing partially digested grass again.
example.traditional: 牛隻會反芻食物，將未完全消化嘅草重新咀嚼。
example.jyutping: ngau4 zek3 wui6 faan2 co1 sik6 mat6 zoeng1 mei6 jyun4 cyun4 siu1 faa3 ge3 cou2 cung4 san1 zeoi2 zoek3
